caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a chicken or hen, rendered in a naturalistic, three-dimensional style that suggests it is a wooden sculpture. The bird is depicted in profile, facing left, standing upright with its tail raised high and its wings partially extended and textured with individual feather details. The body, wings, legs, and tail are all covered with a diamond-shaped crosshatch pattern, imitating the texture of woven or carved wood. The chicken’s claws grip a rounded pedestal base. The comb and beak are also detailed; the eye is round and the contours of the head, neck, and body are clearly outlined. The coloration consists of various shades of brown, giving the appearance of wood, and the background is a plain, off-white or beige color with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Rooster
